defects.description: Repeated dark rounded espresso cards (rgba(41,40,34,0.90), border-radius 24-26px, brass border) wrap almost every scene overlay.
defects.acceptance_target: Open full-bleed editorial typography, varied typographic bands, warm ivory/forest/sage/gold palette tokens, <=2 visually equivalent card layouts across 30s.

defects.description: Internal provenance label '(derived)' leaked into consumer-facing caption ('Balance left: $400 (derived)').
defects.acceptance_target: Zero QA/schema jargon ('derived', 'provenance', 'computed') in any rendered text; internal derivation preserved strictly in ledger_claims.json.

defects.description: Banknote tokens render as flat small green rectangles with '$' mark instead of tactile layered paper tokens with curved trajectories and contact shadow.
defects.acceptance_target: Multi-layered paper-grain illustrative note tokens with perspective tilt, soft contact shadow, and coherent curved paths (3-5 tokens max, no casino rain).

defects.description: FrameMorphBridge uses dark espresso background creating a dark circular iris hole before payoff reveal.
defects.acceptance_target: Bright warm ivory (#F5F0E6) editorial morph bridge / shared-element ledger handoff with zero dark curtain obscuring main takeaway.

defects.description: aspect_morph_editorial leaves a large empty cream gap between top chart and boxed speaker window.
defects.acceptance_target: Balanced architectural split with proportional editorial breakdown filling upper safe zone cleanly and generous wide speaker framing below.

defects.description: Sound cues chosen by shallow speech_act lookup at fixed sf+5 offset without semantic SoundRole enum, rejected-candidate rationale, explicit QuietSpan reasoning, or animation-marker sync.
defects.acceptance_target: Two-pass SemanticSoundDirector assigning typed SoundRole enums, rejected-candidate explanations, QuietSpans, and exact compiled animation-marker frames.

defects.description: Recorded foley library has 0 WAV assets (PARTIAL_FOLEY_ASSETS); audio QA lacks per-cue ablation, speech-band masking ratio, and mono-downmix check.
defects.acceptance_target: Attempt verified CC0 recorded WAV provisioning (honest PARTIAL_FOLEY_ASSETS if unavailable) + add single-cue ablation, 1-4kHz speech masking ratio, peak-lag, and mono-downmix checks.

defects.description: Midpoint-only ablation sampled entry transitions after they already completed (13/15 AUTO, 14/15 benchmark).
defects.acceptance_target: Active-window ablation sampling each layer/transition at its verified active peak frame (entry wipe at entry midpoint, flip at mid-flip, sustained at scene midpoint).

defects.description: No formal Reels safe-zone solver (L>=48, R>=105, T>=110, B>=230), no all-frame face/eye/mouth/hand collision sweep, and no exported SharedElementState continuity tracks.
defects.acceptance_target: Implement art_direction.py exporting layout.json, continuity.json, design_candidates.json, and frame_protection.csv with 0 face/eye/mouth overlaps.

defects.description: 33 separate cold Remotion CLI/Chromium launches and zero content-addressed per-scene/per-overlay render caches cause 611.55s cold runtime.
defects.acceptance_target: Single-bundle + persistent-browser Remotion batch worker + content-addressed Remotion scene & HyperFrames overlay caches with strict invalidation keys, zero visual downgrade.
